records.name: Strands SDK + harness
records.version: Python version tag-derived; TS manifests 0.0.1-development (release context: SDK 1.60/1.20, harness 0.2)
records.one_liner: Parallel Python/TypeScript SDKs with hooks, policy interventions and a harness factory; persistence is snapshot-based.

features_notes.http_server: A2A integration rather than a general full application server.
features_notes.durable_resume: Snapshot/interrupt resume and cycle markers; no journal/scheduler for in-flight work.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Docker/SSH routing and separate Strands Box integration; default host environment has no isolation.
features_notes.approvals: Opt-in interventions in library; CLI supplies policy/prompt defaults.

dims.loop: Model-driven SDK loop; harness factory wires defaults onto ordinary Agent instances.
dims.providers: Bedrock default plus native providers/LiteLLM and TS AI SDK model adapter.
dims.tools: Decorated tools, executors, MCP, sandbox routing and code-mode capability.
dims.context: Context managers, offload/stash, memory and Agent Skills.
dims.state: Snapshots per invocation/message and interrupt state; checkpoint marker alone contains no conversation state.
dims.safety: Cedar/HITL interventions; default NotASandboxLocalEnvironment executes on host, Docker/SSH relocate effects.
dims.extensibility: Hook bus, middleware, plugin classes, interventions and skill/tool discovery.
dims.multi_agent: Agent-as-tool, Graph/Swarm and background delegates; unfinished background work is process-local.
dims.surfaces: Python/TS in-process libraries, browser build and CLI TUI/ACP.
dims.observability: OpenTelemetry hooks and metrics; tracing exporters require configuration.

key_insights: Parallel Python/TypeScript SDKs with hooks, policy interventions and a harness factory; persistence is snapshot-based.
